$comment: FellowPilot brand, from the FellowPilot Brand Identity & Visual Style Guide, concept edition 1.0 (25 Oct 2026). Edit this file and push to change the app's branding; see ../README.md.
name: FellowPilot
tagline: Your partner in lifelong medical learning.
descriptor: Personalised medical learning and professional development
productLine: Practice questions, reflective logbook and progress map for prevocational doctors (PGY1 and PGY2)

roles.$comment: Which palette colour does which job. Values are palette names or hex. Text-safe shades, tints and the dark theme are derived automatically and contrast-checked at build.
roles.heading: purple

fonts.$comment: Nunito Sans is the face used in the logo artwork (free, SIL Open Font License), so the app's text matches the wordmark. The style guide also names Sofia Pro; to use it once licensed, put woff2 files in ./fonts and use { "local": [{ "file": "fonts/SofiaPro-Bold.woff2", "weight": "700" }] }.

logos.$comment: SVG (or PNG) files in this folder. These are the designer's vector logos with the text converted to outlines and the framing fixed so the top leaves aren't cropped; see source/README.md.

icons.$comment: app: the rounded tile shown on home screens and in the browser's app list. full: a square, edge-to-edge version that Android and iOS mask into their own shapes (keep artwork inside the middle 80%). favicon: a simplified mark for browser tabs that still reads at 16 px. Any left out are made from the emblem.
